title: Concept: Scrape target list exposed
description: A Prometheus target list with internal addresses in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The list names every monitored host and port, which is a ready inventory of the internal estate for anyone who can reach the endpoint.
applicability: Deployments that render a Prometheus target list with internal addresses into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The list names every monitored host and port, which is a ready inventory of the internal estate for anyone who can reach the endpoint.
